newsitem.title: GERMANY: BUBA reports M3 money supply growth.
newsitem.headline: BUBA reports M3 money supply growth.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that German M3 money supply growth was boosted by strong borrowing, particularly by the public sector.
In a statement, the central bank said that domestic lending in particular had boosted growth in the month.
A sharp rise in one M3 component, sight deposits, also buoyed the figure. It said the increase in these funds was probably due to money parked there ahead of the issue of Deutsche Telekom AG shares.
M3 growth overall had gained pace somewhat in the course of the month although the headline rate remained unchanged.
